method: Started a fresh Play session, then opened ARMURERIE by calling the running EconomyService.Send from a temporary server Script; the Script self-destroyed.
interpretation: In this Studio place and fresh Play session, every armory card had a camera and non-empty 3D preview geometry; no active UI text or weapon definition marked a model as pending. The player still had Fists equipped, so no separate held weapon model was expected.
cleanup: Play stopped and Studio returned to Edit. No purchase, grant, weapon equip, profile change, DataStore write, place save, or publish.
limitations: No usable Play screenshot was captured; this validates live UI instances and preview geometry, not rendered pixels.
The first-person and third-person held model appearance was not visually inspected.
Graphify index commit aa5accaf was 35 hours old and its query did not provide complete current source context; Studio runtime and current local files were used for verification.
No mobile, controller, multiplayer, or published-place verification was performed.
